items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Clark Terry is one of my best friends... Ben Webster... he was one of the nicest guys I ever met in my life... we got along great.

ctx.x: Would any of these fellas, when they came into town, you would have them over to your house?

Oh all of them came over my house. Papa Jo Jones did, Ben Webster did. Dizzy Gillespie did. I had Oscar Peterson over to my mother’s house for dinner, you know, Oscar Peterson. James Moody, I don’t know if you ever heard of him. Sweets Edison came over my house. Well the reason they came over to my house was because it was a home atmosphere, had kids, they could be themselves. They could get on the floor, sit down and relax, they didn’t have to put on any airs and my wife was a good cook and they liked my kids.…
So your kids were having these famous musicians in their house.
